data.name: Claribel
data.gender_notes: Claribel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Claribel is derived from the Latin words 'clarus' meaning clear or bright and 'bella' meaning beautiful. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the purity and radiance of faith. The name Claribel carries the meaning “Bright, Clear, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Claribel usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, clear, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner light and clarity of one's faith and the beauty of living a virtuous life.
data.etymology: Claribel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, Clear, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Claribel total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: כלאריבל
in_hebrew.meaning: כלאריבל - שם שמקורו בלטיני, שמשמעו 'אור יפה' או 'ניצני אור'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: כלאריבל - שם שמקורו בלטיני, שמשמעו 'אור יפה' או 'ניצני אור'. שם זה עשוי להיות קשור לכוכבים, שמש, או לאור יוצא מן החושך. השם 'כלאריבל' מופיע בראשית 12:1, שם הוא מצוין כאחד מבני שם. באסלאם, 'כלאריבל' הוא שם של אחת הנביאות. בתקופה הקרובה, 'כלאריבל' נפוץ כשם נשים, ונחשב לשם מקורי וחדש.

in_greek.name: Κλαριμπέλ
in_greek.meaning: Κλαριμπέλ - όνομα που προέρχεται από την λατινική γλώσσα, που σημαίνει 'αξιαία' ή 'λαμπρή'
in_greek.long_meaning: Κλαριμπέλ - όνομα που προέρχεται από την λατινική γλώσσα, που σημαίνει 'αξιαία' ή 'λαμπρή'. Το όνομα 'Κλαριμπέλ' μπορεί να σχετιστεί με την κλαριπεία, το όργανο μουσικής, ή με την αγγελία, η οποία είναι μια κλήρωση που γίνεται με κλήρωση. Το όνομα 'Κλαριμπέλ' δεν εμφανίζεται συγκεκριμένα στην Καινή Διαθήκη, αλλά μπορεί να σχετιστεί με την ορατότητα και την κληρονομιά.

in_latin.name: Claribel
in_latin.meaning: Claribel - nomen femininum, significationem habens 'lucem claram' vel 'splendorem'
in_latin.long_meaning: Claribel - nomen femininum, significationem habens 'lucem claram' vel 'splendorem'. Nomen hoc potest esse connexum ad stellas, Solem, aut lumina ex tenebris emergentia. historical_references.reference: According to medieval legend, Claribel was the name of the beautiful queen of the African kingdom of Guineh, whom Dante Alighieri fell deeply in love with during his travels. This historical figure is mentioned in Dante's 'Divine Comedy', specifically in 'Paradise' where she is portrayed as a virtuous and noble woman residing in the Earthly Paradise.

Another historical reference for the name Claribel comes from the 12th-century Old French romance 'Claribel, ou La Belle Clarice'. In this story, Claribel is the beautiful daughter of the king of Sicily who is courted by both King Arthur and Rudolf of Hainaut. The story explores themes of love, loyalty, and self-sacrifice.
